name: rubato-cursor
description: Rubato (musical term: stolen time) model-state monitor for Cursor: derives AI working state from workspace edit bursts (Estimate/Thinking/Generating/Done), estimates duration locally (feature-based kNN), and publishes lean records to EMQX (rubato/<deviceId>/state) with derived clientId CUR-<username>.

commands.title: Rubato: Send Test Cycle to Device

rubato.modelLabel.description: Model name carried in MQTT payloads; also the estimator's per-model history key.

rubato.settleMs.description: Quiet time (ms) after the last AI-like edit before the burst is closed with Done.

rubato.minBurstChars.description: Inserted+deleted chars above which a single edit counts as AI work (smaller edits count only outside the focused editor).

rubato.maxBurstMs.description: Safety cap (ms): a burst that keeps receiving edits is closed with Done after this long.
